info.name: Home Truth RAG API
info.description: Complete API collection for Home Truth backend with RAG system integration

request.description: Login endpoint for admin users only. Requires admin role.
Join the HomeTruth waitlist. Users will receive a confirmation email after joining.
Upload up to 20 documents (PDF, DOCX, TXT). Documents will be processed and stored in vector database for RAG.

query.description: Filter by entry method (file_upload, url_scrape, manual_entry)

request.description: Get formatted document list for Document Library UI. Returns documents with document_hash, formatted dates, source URLs, file types, chunk counts, and all metadata needed for display.
Get detailed information about a specific document with formatted metadata for Document Library display.
Get a preview of document content. Returns formatted preview with document hash, source URL, and metadata. Used for Document Library preview feature.
Add knowledge to knowledge base by scraping a URL. Admin only. The URL will be scraped and content extracted automatically.

body.raw:
{
  "title": "First-time Buyer Checklist",

  "category": "Buying Process",
  "documentId": "checklist_001",
  "priority": "Normal",
  "source": "Internal",
  "tags": ["homebuying", "first-time-buyer", "uk", "property", "process"]
}

request.description: Add knowledge to knowledge base by manually entering title and content. Admin only.

formdata.description: JSON array of tags as string

request.description: Add knowledge to knowledge base by uploading a file (PDF, DOCX, TXT). Admin only. Supports additional metadata fields.
Get AI-suggested metadata (category, tags, priority, source) based on document title and content. Admin only.
Search across the knowledge base using semantic search. Supports filtering by category, tags, and source. Admin only.
Upload multiple documents (up to 50 files) to the knowledge base in batch. Files will be processed concurrently. Admin only.

Get Knowledge Base Stats formatted for dashboard UI. Returns: Total Records (combined across all namespaces), General Namespace count, Embedding Dimension, and Namespace Breakdown table with vector counts. Matches the dashboard stats view. Admin only.
Export knowledge base data in JSON format. Can filter by category and limit results. Admin only.
Export knowledge base data as CSV file download. Can filter by category. Admin only.
Start a new chat. The AI will use your uploaded documents as context for responses.
Continue an existing conversation using conversation_id from previous response.
Save or unsave a conversation. Users can save up to 3 conversations.
Chat with web search enabled for current stamp duty rates and calculations.
Chat with web search enabled for current mortgage rates and market conditions.
Chat with web search enabled for current property valuations and market data.
Chat without authentication. Limited to 6 messages per session.

Continue the AI budget calculation conversation
Manually update a specific budget calculation field
Update all budget calculation fields at once
Generate budget estimate from chat data
Get current budget calculation status and progress
Get all budget calculations for the user
Get only saved budget calculations
Mark a budget calculation as saved with a custom name
Update the name of a budget calculation
Create a new quiz question
Get all quiz questions (requires authentication)
Get all quiz questions with their correct answers (requires authentication)
Get a specific quiz question by ID
Get a specific question with all its options
Get all questions with their options

Get all quiz options

Create a saved note from chat history with a custom title. chat_history_id is required, title is optional.
Create a saved note from chat history without title. Will auto-generate title as 'Note from [date]'

item.name: Get All Saved Items (Notes + Budget Calculations)

request.description: Get user's profile preferences. Returns 404 if no preferences exist - use POST to create them first.

Create or update profile preferences. Valid values: communication_tone (formal, friendly, encouraging), communication_style (bullet_points, narrative_summary, visual_aids), behavior (follow_ups, link_notes, checklist)
Update existing profile preferences. Note: User must have existing preferences first (use POST to create)
Upload property documents (PDF, DOCX, JPG, PNG). AI will analyze and extract metadata like document type, category, tags, dates, and expiry dates.
Get paginated list of user documents with filtering options (category, status, doc_type, search).
Get statistics about user's documents (total count, by category, by status, by type).
Get detailed information about a specific document including AI analysis results.
Stream document file for preview in browser (PDF, images, etc.).
Update document metadata (doc_type, status, category, tags, dates).
Update only the filename of a document without affecting other metadata. Filename must be a non-empty string and cannot exceed 255 characters.
Soft delete a document (removes from vector database and marks as inactive).
Search across all user documents using semantic search with optional filters.
Get a preview of the document content with metadata and extracted information.
Ask questions about a specific document. AI will use RAG to provide context-aware answers.
Get chat history for a specific document. Optionally filter by conversation_id.

query.description: Optional: Filter by specific conversation ID

request.description: Get all chats for a document with pagination and optional conversation filtering. Returns chats in reverse chronological order (most recent first).
Get AI-generated summary of the document highlighting key information.
Get AI-generated suggested questions based on document type and content.
Get detailed AI analysis and insights about the document including potential issues and recommendations.
